name: drengr
description: Eyes and hands for AI agents on Android and iOS devices.
long_description: Drengr gives AI agents the ability to see, understand, and interact with Android and iOS devices. Three MCP tools: drengr_look (observe screen with annotated screenshots), drengr_do (tap, type, swipe, navigate), and drengr_query (check devices, crashes, find elements). Single Rust binary, zero runtime dependencies.

tools.name: drengr_look
tools.description: Observe the current screen. Returns an annotated screenshot with numbered interactive elements.

tools.name: drengr_do
tools.description: Execute an action on the device (tap, type, swipe, navigate) and get a situation report.

tools.name: drengr_query
tools.description: Quick read-only queries: check devices, current activity, crash status, find elements.
